messages:
mia: quick one — noticed the metrics gridlines in dark mode are barely visible on some monitors. on 1440p the thin 1px stroke + ink-700 at 12% feels washed out. thinking we should either bump weight or increase contrast. preview: https://redwood-inference.dev/preview/gridlines-issue :eyes:

sam: saw that. agree — they disappear on HDR panels. +1 to increasing contrast. my quick thought: keep 1px but change color to something like rgba(255,255,255,0.06) -> rgba(255,255,255,0.10). also for small multiples maybe alternate every other row with 0.04 alpha so the ear can track lines without adding visual noise.

jordan: accessibility note — we should aim for >= 3:1 contrast for chart gridlines vs background where they convey structure. for axis ticks/labels keep 4.5:1. i ran a quick check: background #0b0f13 with gridline #2b3140 @ 0.12 =~ 2.6:1 (too low).

alex: agree with jordan. also related: syntax highlighting in the console panels — keywords are pretty close to body copy now. when we increase gridline contrast, the code panels look flatter. proposal: make keywords slightly more saturated and bump string color warmer so they separate from the background. example CSS vars: 
```css
--ink-100: #0b0f13;
--syntax-keyword: #8b5cf6; /* violet, +10% sat */
--syntax-string: #7cc783; /* warm green */
--syntax-number: #f59e0b; /* amber for visibility */
```

sam: love the amber for numbers — that helps scanning. for charts, let's also pick colorblind-friendly palette (3 colors max): blue-ish (#4ea8ff), teal (#30cfc8), amber (#f6b042). these are ok at smaller opacities for overlays.

mia: nit — can we avoid pure white for any accents? it spikes on OLED. prefer near-white #f5f7fa for high-contrast text.

jordan: echo on contrast. also recommend we add a lightweight token border for chips in dark mode: 1px inset with rgba(255,255,255,0.03) helps separation without being noisy. test with 2x zoom and low gamma displays.

alex: i'll spin up a quick PR with two variants: A) heavier gridlines + subtle token borders + syntax saturation bump, B) keep gridlines but alternate row backgrounds. will post snapshots in this thread.

designbot: preview build created -> https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/branches/feature/dark-gridline-tweaks (expires in 48h) :rocket:

mia: nice — checking now. first impression: variant A feels clearer, but the axis labels look a hair dense. can we increase label letter-spacing by 0.02em?

sam: tiny tweak — for heatmaps keep the token border off (it creates moiré). for line charts we keep it on.

jordan: thumbs up on spacing tweak. also flag: remember to run color contrast tests for exported PNGs (our charts are embedded as images in some emails). those need explicit color choices or they'll fail contrast heuristics in dark backgrounds.

alex: noted. i'll include exported PNG checks in the PR CI. planning to merge after one more thumbs-up.

mia: :thumbsup: i'm happy with variant A after the axis spacing tweak. thanks all — will close the loop with product on copy alignment (axis prefixes, unit labels) after merge.

sam: :+1:

jordan: :eyes: will run quick accessibility pass post-merge.

designbot: PR updated with axis letter-spacing tweak -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4823
